description: This file defines a set of type converter functions for use with Room database in an Android application. It contains methods to convert between Date objects and Long or String representations for database storage.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A class providing methods annotated with @TypeConverter to facilitate conversion between Date objects and their primitive representations (Long and String) for database storage.

methods.name: fromTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a Long timestamp value to a Date object.

methods.name: dateToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a Date object to a Long timestamp.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a String representation of a timestamp to a Date object.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Converts a Date object to its String representation of the timestamp.
